messages:
maria: Repro dump from the long-context fuzz playback run. Observed steady memory growth and a spike in KV slot fragmentation around 1.2M tokens. Putting steps and logs below so we can triage.

aj: Can you paste the exact command you used and the env? I want to run locally.

maria: Command: ```./bin/kv_fuzz_runner --workload longplayback --duration 45m --seed 4271 --trace-kv=compact,allocs --report /tmp/kvplayback.json``` Env: `KV_DEBUG=1 KV_COMPACT_THRESH=0.55` Kernel: hhvm-vec-opt build.

becca: Quick scan: that compact threshold seems low for interleaved sequences. Did the run include batching variations?

maria: Yes, we randomized batching heuristics: `BATCH_POLICY=adaptive,mini_batch=8,max_batch=64,age_mult=1.5`. I think the adaptive policy is causing stray small KV fragments when short and long contexts interleave.

samir: Interesting — I saw similar behavior when kernel selection fell back from our optimized fused-kernel to the generic path. That increases KV write churn. Any `perf`/pprof output?

maria: Attached top of pprof heap: ```# top 5 by allocated bytes
134M  38.2%  kv::slot_map::compact
82M   23.4%  kv::lazy_fragment
45M   12.9%  runtime::tensor_cache
33M   9.4%   batcher::pending_queue
...``` Also saw many `freelist` hits low while allocation spikes.

aj: Can you repro with `KERNEL_OVERRIDE=fused` and `BATCH_POLICY=static,mini_batch=16,max_batch=16` to see if it's batching or kernel?

maria: Ran that after you posted: with fused kernel + static mini_batch=16 the memory plateaued and fragmentation markers dropped. So two levers seem to interact: kernel choice + batching distribution.

becca: Sounds like a regression introduced when we changed kernel selection heuristics to prefer generic for low-latency short ctxs. Might be #ISSUE-1024.

perf-bot: ci/regressions: kv-compactness-smoke failed on branch `main` (build 7684). See /ci/artifacts/7684/kv-compactness.log : `mem_growth=+0.27GB over 30m`

samir: Can we add a deterministic regression test: replay the longplayback trace with `KERNEL_OVERRIDE=fused` and assert `mem_growth < 100MB`? If that passes then kernel fallback is culprit.

maria: Proposal PR: `eng-runtime/kv/bench: add playback-regtest-longplayback` — johnny will add harness that runs 10m fuzz seed with trace and an assertion on `peak_rss - baseline_rss`. I'll draft the PR and include a reproducer script `tools/kv/replay_capture.sh` and a short doc in `docs/kv/repro.md`.

aj: Also add a flaky tag and set to run only on nightly until we root cause.

becca: One more ask: dump the KV physical layout after run (json) and include offsets + hole map. That helped me find that small fragments were always 128B aligned which pointed to allocator interaction.

maria: Will attach `kv_layout_after.json` and the eye-ball diff. For next steps: 1) add regtest + nightly job, 2) run with kernel override matrix, 3) instrument freelist/allocator to expose fragmentation ratio in telemetry.

samir: I'll pick up the telemetry patch. aj you ok to own the regtest PR?

aj: Yep, I'll open it tomorrow and link the issue.

maria: Thanks all. Filing a short follow-up issue with the reproduction artifacts and the command list: https://redwood/issue/ENG-2137.

perf-bot: note: added label `perf:kv-fragmentation` to ENG-2137.
